_about: How the Magic Portals port carries a traveller through a portal. The remake's
portals.json has a transit block, and marks every field of it _guess; this is the
original's rule, decoded from its compiled script, and it replaces that block. See

_source: (PortalManager.angelscript, bytes 144944..145873) puts the traveller at its partner
portal's own position, SetPositionXY(other.GetPositionXY()), with no offset, and then
a body's velocity by -1, and a character's by (1, -1): the character keeps its x and
turns its y back. There is no speed scale.
_lockout_note: Kept from the remake's portals.json, where it is a _guess. Nothing in teleportToOther
waits; the original stops a traveller going straight back by other means, which are
not decoded. The port's entries are edges, as body_entered is, so a traveller put down
